zh: DragonClaw 回复下方的复制按钮旁新增「问题反馈」按钮：点击后自动收集本对话的研发日志，打开意见反馈弹窗并附上日志，描述问题后提交，就会在需求广场生成一条「意见反馈」。
意见反馈支持上传任意格式的附件（最多 5 个，合计 20 MB）；附件只有提交人和超级管理员可以下载，需求详情里会列出附件。
en: A "Report a problem" button now sits next to Copy under each DragonClaw reply: it collects this chat's developer log, opens the feedback dialog with the log attached, and posts your description to the requests board as feedback.
Feedback now accepts attachments of any type (up to 5 files, 20 MB in total); only the submitter and super admins can download them, and request details list them.
